items.title: Avalanche set 2026-27 training camp roster
items.summary: Colorado brought 29 forwards, 20 defensemen and seven goalies to camp this week. On-ice sessions run Thursday through Saturday ahead of a compressed, four-game preseason under the league's new collective-bargaining timeline — opening night lands just 13 days after camp opens.

items.title: Cale Makar dealing with lower-body injury
items.summary: The reigning Norris-caliber defenseman is listed as questionable for the start of the season with a lower-body issue. Colorado hasn't given a firm return timeline; the app's win-probability model applies a small penalty to Colorado's rating in games before he's confirmed back.

items.title: Rookies impress at development camp ahead of San Jose tournament
items.summary: Prospects including goaltender Ilya Nabokov and forward TJ Hughes drew praise heading into the rookie tournament in San Jose. Several 2026 draft picks were among the group, with a couple of names considered outside shots to push for a bigger role this season.

items.title: Martin Necas embraces bigger role entering 2026-27
items.summary: After a full season in burgundy and blue, Necas is expected to take on an expanded offensive role alongside the top line as camp opens.

items.title: Colorado adds depth: Beckman, Merkulov, Lysell, Juulsen signed
items.summary: The Avalanche rounded out their forward and defense depth over the summer, signing winger Adam Beckman, center Georgii Merkulov, winger Fabian Lysell and defenseman Noah Juulsen to give Jared Bednar more options through camp.
